message: Long story short: if you want your luggage to arrive when you do, don't fly [US Airways](http://www.usairways.com/awa/). Nice model of professionalism, US Airways: you've clearly worked to develop a brand identity of [bumbling incompetence](http://www.usairways.com/awa/) and blank and ugly [hostility towards passengers](http://www.usairways.com/awa/).
